engine: Java 26.3 flat-court sword duel, production simulator at 33fb0c8b
training: Ongoing main and champion-targeting responses, archived hard opponents, empirical opponent mixture, and complete-state action forks. Generic outcomes and HP. W-tap reserved for grading.
comparison: Balance both seats and zero/100 ms added RTT, fixed kit, own inputs and bounded aim. Freeze each finalist before fresh ordinary Java. Keep all successful counters; compare each finalist and a W-tap control to the same rivals.
promotion: A fresh ordinary Java majority directly against the incumbent, plus more total wins than the incumbent on a common multi-opponent field and more than plain W-tap. Count draws as half. Require a second independent opening panel for a close or split result. Audit start geometry and report per-latency spread.
stopping: Look for three fresh independent search seasons without improved generalist performance or a new effective counter, then spend a larger independent search budget on a final challenge. Verify the strongest counter and finalist against the current incumbent in ordinary Java. A known counter that continues winning is a remaining vulnerability; do not describe that single policy as unbeatable. Continue if new transferable counters or a promoted champion appear.
cpu: 12 logical host cores. Three or four low-priority rollout workers with a small serial-GC JVM, or one headless four-vCPU guest for native tests. Heavy training and the game guest run at different times. Record process usage and wall time.
validation: Development panels and model selection openings stay separate from subsequent fresh Java promotions and final audits. Each new search and evaluation uses a different seed.

season_design.payoff_matrix_mixture: 50% symmetric empirical regret-matching mixture, 30% recent main vulnerability, 20% uniform
season_design.practical_model_improvement: Generalist: >1.2 percentage points in 75% mean / 25% lowest-quarter matchup score and >51.5% against preceding main on fresh confirmation. Counter: at least 55% against current main and 2.5 percentage points above the strongest archived response. Draws count half.
season_design.strongest_search: 320 generations in each main and direct response population, 640 independent fresh population generations, 2048 full-history fork states per physical control, 480 recurrent PPO updates.
season_design.native_schedule: First nominations after three seasons, then after six or at a confirmed plateau. Nominate the strongest across the learned field and strongest direct response to the live champion. Ordinary Java tests both with the incumbent and W-tap on identical requested openings; all arms in a cell need first-input pose error <= 1e-5 blocks. Retain every result.
season_design.native_confirmation: Extra fresh panel when an apparent promotion has less than 75% head-to-head, a losing latency, a specialist alone appears to win, an unqualified opening occurred, or final search produced a possible promotion.
